reflections.summary: Restrict and chain temporal links; aspect decision order; adverb/modifier attachment and re-entrancy rules; non-core role choices (:place, :medium, :part-of, :reason); classifiers kept as :unit; title brackets in names; have-degree-91 for comparison; but-91/contrast-91 take ARG1/ARG2; stricter same-event and fused-negation rules.

Firm temporal anchoring rules (aspectual verbs, nominal args, depends-on for present), no borrowed participants, fused-negation concept/aspect/modal, aspect rule 2 restricted, no wiki in Chinese, superlative over verb, history-phrase temporal, small role/coref fixes.

Fix aspectual-verb temporal direction and fame pattern; give relative-clause states and copulas modal (and RC states temporal) parents; fused-negation nested event parent = author; concrete belong-type role convention; restrict aspect step 2 (continue -> activity); alignment of repeated words.

Fix temporal conventions (past dates DCT :before, date :overlap event, purpose :overlap, reason before result, RC completed event before, narrative anchors to DCT); reify paired reason/purpose as have-reason-91/have-purpose-91; widen no-borrowing rule; component-noun head, 由X改为Y roles, 量 decomposition; individual-person, have-org-role-91, appositive identity-91, middle dot op; aspect/modifier details.

Quantity-noun inner nodes get no aspect/modal (have-quant-91 no temporal), measures not coreferent; full node at first mention; change-clause components take subject as :part-of; trailing clause attaches to component noun; contains = process; appositive identity-91 gets no attributes/links; 也+成为 triggers link to previous anchor; habitual widened to production practices incl. nouns; decades :era and :overlap; no frame for sentence-initial connectives.

Clarify full-node placement by text order; part-of in change clauses even when the entity is reused; pre-apposition modifiers go on the apposition noun; have-org-role-91 holder is always ARG1; habitual covers production practices incl. nominals, and content verbs of publications are process.

Compress the intro and preamble to make room. Add rules for: 以Y为目的 as identity-91 (have-purpose-91 only for purpose clauses); parenthetical identity-91 clauses; 是 Adj as have-mod-91; 等 as last :opN, :example lists, 有-03 with (and A B); control-verb subject re-entrancy and shared contrast time; aspect fixes (nominal under aspectual verb = process, exist/survive = state, past speech act = performance); speaker as conceiver of all reported content plus :quote; no links for nodes without aspect; individual-person for characters, planet NEs; consecutive for 后来, no node for discourse 就; same-sentence short-form coref; marriage titles.

Freed space by trimming redundant text; added rules for same-sentence pronoun vs repeated-noun coreference, paired concessive -> but-91, mandatory :quote, 后来 chain subject re-entry, :frequency adverbs, location postpositions/roleset location args, named characters and category nouns before names, coordination anchor and no temporal parent for have-mod-91/identity-91, implicit-argument; checklist updated.

Coref restricted (no generic/example-list nouns; repeated name in slogan/parenthesis = re-entrancy); reported-content modal: author+speaker parents, nominals author-only, passive 被指 conceiver = content subject; temporal: date opening but-91 on both clauses, still/continue overlap, restating clauses hang on content main event; superlative with dropped head (implicit-argument, ARG5 partitive); 出现-type role convention; aspect fixes; trimmed redundant text for space.

Add: 「」 article titles as unanalysed publication names; named year-events; split verb+人/者 (agent/patient) and prefix+noun compounds; attributive modifiers with a roleset become inverse-role events; have-example-91, but-91 anchor, 为了 shared subject, publication parts :part-of, 有-06 ability, 靠 as :reason. Trim redundant text to fit.

Reported speech modal structure (speaker under author, reporting verbs under speaker, content author-only, :quote on all content events); 时 phrases and year-event names; news noun + title head and ability identity-91; general predicate+人/者 split and prefix :mod; no nodes for clause-chaining 还/甚至/也; -00 rule, V到, 靠-type :reason; discourse frames without aspect/modal; :topic roles; chained conjuncts; reported dates. Removed narrow rules and redundant checklist lines to fit.

Fix dropped-subject re-entrancy rule, restrict habitual, fronted 为了 -> have-reason-91, no nodes for additive 还/也/甚至, add 靠/有能力/如/全/V到/-00/patient 人 constructions, ban :poss, temporal fixes (chained conjuncts, reported past, participles, evaluative statements), modal conjunct conceiver and headline complement; trim redundancies for space.
